basic_details.organization_name: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR)
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) has officially released the Research Associate Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt. No. CPMU/INST/63/26-27) for 1 vacancy at JNCASR, Bengaluru. Eligible candidates possessing a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or candidates with three years of research, teaching, design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/M.E./M.Tech along with at least one research paper published in a Science Citation Index (SCI) journal, can apply. Applicants must be not more than 35 years of age. The appointment is on a contractual basis with

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Associate position at JNCASR is 10th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree. Alternatively, three years of research, teaching, design, and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/M.E/M.Tech with at least one SCI journal publication is acceptable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 35 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 47,000 to Rs. 54,000, along with an additional 24% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate role will primarily involve an online interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this JNCASR recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Research Associate is on a contract basis. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure as specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), a prominent research institution.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
